adaptation_notes: Official SoyDNGPNext model.yaml network (18.1M params) built by official remodel(); official one_hot_CPU + np.resize to 3x206x206.
DArT 0/1 markers are mapped to VCF codes 0/0 -> 3 and 1/1 -> 1 (no heterozygous or missing calls in wheat.X); the 1279 markers are tiled by np.resize exactly as upstream does for shorter panels.
Target min/max normalization uses the current fit subset only (upstream normalizes with the whole trait column); predictions are mapped back to the released wheat.Y scale.
Official train_n uses a random 70/30 split, min-r checkpointing and a fixed epoch count; replaced by protocol inner folds, validation-PCC selection and median-epoch full-dev refit.
Package __init__ imports cupy/matplotlib/onnxruntime; adapter loads SoyDNGP.py/remodel.py/reader_cpu.py directly without those GPU-report dependencies.
